title: docs(adr-0135): D4 gains a dated note for the third identity-source writer (SCIM provisioning) and its boot backfill
body:
security#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

**Filing gate ②: a contract-review finding.** The contract review of #32400 on `0113ef3331` (comment 6792533556, boundary flag) graded this should-fix and owed it before landing.

ADR-0135 D4 names two writers of the row mark `sys_user.source`, and says both fail open. #32400 adds a third writer:
- **Where it writes.** On the SCIM provisioning path, inside the directory's transaction.
- **Active states.** It fails closed: a mark that cannot be written fails the provisioning request, and the identity provider retries.
- **Deprovision.** On deactivation and delete it is best-effort, after the deprovision write, so a failed mark never leaves the account enabled.
- **Boot backfill.** A one-time, idempotent pass marks users the directory provisioned before the change.

D4's writer list is how a reader of the ADR learns where the mark comes from.

## Asked

Add a dated Note under ADR-0135 D4. The note should:
- name the SCIM provisioning writer and its two postures;
- name the boot backfill;
- explain why the fail-closed posture is right for a provisioning request the identity provider retries, when a sign-in must never break;
- cite #32400 and this card.

This is a governed path (Tier H), so it lands with the maintainer's approval.

## Not asked

Any behaviour change.
